name: Sovetskie Stringi Stilja Retro
source:
A young college graduate Artem arrives at his first-ever job. However what at first seems to be an unremarkable position of an ordinary employee of a garment factory leads him to a number of fantastic adventures.

Artem expects to meet with strange phenomena, unusual incidents, the investigation of intricate matters and, of course, meetings with the beautiful Soviet women!

Artem is destined to find out that there is sex in the USSR too!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/ErosAmor]Patreon[/url]]

等待阿尔乔姆的，有诡异的现象、离奇的事件、错综复杂的调查，当然，还有与美丽苏联女性的邂逅！
